executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,re,hashlib
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_purchase_adjustment_current_report_cause_review_v1'
p=OUT/'全部24月原字段_正文_时点评分绑定.json'
records=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(records)==24
reviews=[];unique_theme={};manufacturing_text=[]
for r in records:
 paras=r['prose_paragraphs']
 retained=[];nested=[]
 for pi,txt in enumerate(paras):
  children=[(j,t) for j,t in enumerate(paras) if j!=pi and len(t)>20 and t in txt]
  is_aggregate=len(txt)>1500 and len(children)>=8
  if is_aggregate:nested.append({'paragraph_index':pi,'contained_leaf_paragraphs':len(children),'status':'AGGREGATED_PARENT_NOT_INDEPENDENT_PROSE'})
  else:retained.append((pi,txt))
 body=[];methods=[];appendix=False
 for pi,txt in retained:
  if re.search(r'附[注录]',txt):appendix=True
  if appendix:methods.append((pi,txt))
  else:body.append((pi,txt))
 assert body and methods,(r['stat_month'],'正文与附注必须有原位置边界')
 manufacturing=[];started=False
 for pi,txt in body:
  if '中国制造业采购经理指数运行情况' in txt:started=True
  if '中国非制造业采购经理指数运行情况' in txt:break
  if started:manufacturing.append((pi,txt))
 assert manufacturing,(r['stat_month'],'制造业章节未识别')
 # 这里只筛主题，直接因果等级由读完下列全部候选后另存人工裁决。
 theme=[]
 for pi,txt in body:
  clean=txt.replace('中国物流与采购联合会','发布单位').replace('制造业采购经理指数','制造业PMI').replace('非制造业采购经理指数','非制造业PMI').replace('采购经理指数','PMI')
  if any(w in clean for w in ['采购','购入','买入','备料','备货','囤货','订货']):
   theme.append({'paragraph_index':pi,'text':txt,'grade':'PENDING_DIRECT_CAUSE_REVIEW'})
 for item in r['purchase_theme_candidates']:
  if any(item['paragraph_index']==pi for pi,_ in methods):grade='METHODOLOGY_NOT_CURRENT_MONTH_CAUSE'
  elif item['text']=='中国物流与采购联合会':grade='PUBLISHER_NOT_CURRENT_MONTH_CAUSE'
  elif any(item['paragraph_index']==n['paragraph_index'] for n in nested):grade='AGGREGATED_PARENT_CONTAINS_METHODOLOGY_AND_BODY'
  else:grade='CURRENT_BODY_REVIEW_PENDING'
  key=(grade,item['text'])
  unique_theme.setdefault(key,{'grade':grade,'text':item['text'],'months':[]})['months'].append(r['stat_month'])
 reviews.append({'stat_month':r['stat_month'],'purchase_level':r['current_month_fields']['采购量'],'purchase_change_pp':r['purchase_change_pp'],'manufacturing_current_body':[{'paragraph_index':pi,'text':txt} for pi,txt in manufacturing],'all_current_body_purchase_theme':theme,'appendix_paragraph_count':len(methods),'aggregated_parent_excluded_count':len(nested),'original_full_prose_preserved':True,'direct_purchase_cause_review_status':'PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW'})
 manufacturing_text.extend(['# '+r['stat_month'],'',r['source_url'],'']+[str(pi)+'．'+txt for pi,txt in manufacturing]+[''])
p=OUT/'全部24月分层正文_待人工裁决.json';assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(reviews,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
p=OUT/'全部24月制造业正文_逐月核对.md';assert not p.exists()
p.write_text('\n'.join(manufacturing_text)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
filtered=[v for v in unique_theme.values() if v['grade']!='AGGREGATED_PARENT_CONTAINS_METHODOLOGY_AND_BODY']
p=OUT/'方法发布者主题_去重复分层定位.json';assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(filtered,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'正文核对月数':24,'本月采购行为主题段落':sum(len(r['all_current_body_purchase_theme']) for r in reviews),'方法或发布者采购主题去重':len(filtered),'全原文':'保留','原分数CSV未来收益列':'usecols未读取','原输入parquet额外列':'曾完整载入但未使用未来标签，本文不依赖其值'},ensure_ascii=False))
for r in reviews:
 print(r['stat_month'],'采购量',r['purchase_level'],'月变',r['purchase_change_pp'],'正文采购候选',json.dumps(r['all_current_body_purchase_theme'],ensure_ascii=False))
 print('制造业正文',json.dumps(r['manufacturing_current_body'],ensure_ascii=False))
